item.title: Embedding External Video Links in Blogs
item.description: Most mainstream streaming platforms support embedding code for external links. However, as of August 11, 2022, Bilibili’s (when is it shutting down?) default embed link defaults to 360P and doesn’t allow quality adjustments. It’s pretty frustrating compared to YouTube. Below are the parameters and methods for customizing Bilibili’s embed links.
